test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

They were grateful for a bread we gave them.
solution:
The correct answer is '**for a bread**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The usage of '**a**' before '**bread**' is incorrect in this sentence.
 
• '**Bread**' is an uncountable noun and doesn't take the indefinite article '**a**' or '**an**' before it.
 
• We can say '**a piece of bread**', '**a loaf of bread**', '**some bread**' but not '**a bread**'.
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase would be '**for the bread**' or '**for some bread**' depending on the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.
